headlines.title: Uber (UBER) vs. DoorDash (DASH): Is Faster Growth Worth Paying More For?
headlines.summary: Uber Technologies, Inc. (NYSE:UBER) and DoorDash, Inc. (NASDAQ:DASH) have returned -1% and 22% over the past six months, compared to a 21.25% return for the Insider Monkey Billionaire Index and 14% for State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, as of October 12. Uber and DoorDash are both expanding beyond their original businesses.

headlines.title: Uber autonomous head Maredia to depart as leadership shifts continue - Bloomberg
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Uber Technologies Inc (NYSE:UBER) is facing another high-level departure within its self-driving unit as the ride-hailing giant works to scale its driverless strategy, according to Bloomberg. Sarfraz Maredia, a 12-year company veteran serving as global head of autonomous mobility and delivery, will step down next month to pursue a top executive role outside the transportation sector.

headlines.title: Empiric Earth Names Former Uber Chief Business Development Officer Jen Vescio President
headlines.summary: Empiric Earth today named Jen Vescio President, effective immediately. Vescio, a member of the company's board since April and former Chief Business Development Officer at Uber, reports to Chief Executive Officer Zach Greenberger.

headlines.title: TripleLift Named First Partner for Uber Advertising's U.S. Offsite Audience Expansion
headlines.summary: TripleLift, the Creative SSP powered by TL Spark, today announced it has been selected as the first partner for Uber Advertising's offsite audience expansion in the US. For the first time, advertisers can extend Uber's high-intent consumer signals - derived from how people move, order, and shop - beyond Uber's owned apps and across TripleLift's premium open internet.

headlines.title: Uber (UBER) Is Betting Billions on Delivery. Can Its Cash Flow Justify the Expansion?
headlines.summary: Uber Technologies, Inc. (NYSE:UBER) is making a bigger push into food delivery and corporate catering. On October 6, the company reported that it had agreed to acquire US catering platform ezCater for $2.3 billion in an all-cash deal. This marks its latest effort to strengthen its delivery business, which is the company’s fastest-growing segment.

description: Uber Technologies, Inc. develops and operates proprietary technology applications in the United States, Canada, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. The company operates through three segments: Mobility, Delivery, and Freight. The Mobility segment connects consumers with a range of transportation modalities, such as ridesharing, carsharing, micromobility, rentals, public transit, taxis, and other modalities; and offers riders in a variety of vehicle types, as well as financial partnerships products and advertising services. The Delivery segment allows consumers to search for and discover restaurants to grocery, alcohol, convenience, and other retailers, as well as order a meal or other items, and either pick-up at the restaurant or have it delivered; and provides Uber direct, a white-label delivery-as-a-service for retailers and restaurants, as well as advertising services. The Freight segment manages transportation and logistics networks, which connects shippers and carriers in digital marketplace, including carriers upfronts, pricing, and shipment booking; and offers on-demand platform to automate logistics end-to-end transactions for small-and medium-sized businesses to global enterprises. Uber Technologies, Inc. has staetegic partnership with Mews to embed ride booking, real-time tracking and integrated billing directly into the Mews platform. The company was formerly known as Ubercab, Inc. and changed its name to Uber Technologies, Inc. in February 2011. Uber Technologies, Inc. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
